name: Telegram
description: Fixed TDLib messaging, chat and file requests through an authorized caller-bound native session.

setup.description: Supply CallOptions.native_session bound to the authorized session. This package does not select accounts or start a session from a token.

auth_methods.description: Uses an already authorized caller-bound TDLib session. Credentials and sign-in are supplied during native session setup.

setup.description: Create and authorize a TDLib session using a Telegram application api_id/api_hash and the selected bot or user flow, then pass the bound native session.

actions.name: Send message
actions.description: Send message using TDLib sendMessage on the supplied session. Returns final native message receipts; timeout preserves confirmed member IDs and never resends.
actions.guidance: Submits once and joins pending native message IDs to terminal receipts. Progress reports each confirmed member before joining the next. An incomplete receipt or callback failure retains safe native IDs and does not authorize resubmission.
